steps: Cook brown rice in 600 ml unsalted vegetable broth in a covered saucepan over low heat for 25 minutes.
Drain firm tofu and press for 10 minutes; crumble into rough pea-sized pieces with your hands.
Dice zucchini into 1 cm pieces; grate carrot (cooked); mince garlic; roughly chop spinach.
Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add crumbled tofu and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden on most sides.
Push tofu to one side; add remaining 10 ml olive oil, garlic, zucchini, and carrot to the skillet.
Cook vegetables for 4 minutes over medium heat, stirring, until tender.
Stir in spinach and tamari; cook for 1 minute until spinach wilts.
Add cooked brown rice to the skillet and toss everything together over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle with ground sesame seeds; yields about 4 family portions — refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 2 months.
